'''2007 Australian Championship Chris DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris]] at [[2007 Australian Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Chris' DS Deck
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
